title: Netgear GS108E 8-Port Gigabit Plus Managed Desktop Switch

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Netgear GS108E 8-Port Gigabit Plus Managed Desktop Switch is a reliable and cost-effective networking solution designed for small businesses, home offices, and professional workgroups. It delivers high-speed Gigabit Ethernet performance with essential Smart Managed Plus features, offering more control than unmanaged switches without the complexity of fully managed models.


With a fanless metal design, silent operation, and easy web-based management, the GS108E is ideal for expanding wired networks while ensuring smooth traffic management and improved network efficiency.


Key Features


  • 8 × 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet ports
  • Smart Managed Plus switch with simple web GUI
  • Supports VLAN, QoS, and IGMP Snooping
  • Fanless metal chassis for silent operation
  • Plug-and-play installation with advanced control options
  • Compact desktop design, ideal for small spaces
